full_prompt_en: A square black-and-cream comic illustration depicts a crowded evening restaurant, with a poised woman occupying the foreground. She sits along the lower right in a long sleeveless black gown, one hand braced beside her and her torso turned toward the viewer. Her dark wavy hair frames a composed face with direct eyes and sharply drawn lips. To the left, formally dressed diners sit around a pale tablecloth, their gestures and overlapping chairs suggesting conversation. Behind her, men in dark suits stand among lightly drawn wall panels and an archway, forming a busy but restrained social backdrop. The woman's gown is a large uninterrupted pool of black ink, establishing the strongest contrast against her pale arms and the warm cream paper. Faces are shaped by fine hatching and crisp contour lines, while the deeper room breaks into rougher, quicker strokes. Shadows gather beneath furniture and in the arch, but no single physical lamp is visible. The implied indoor lighting falls most clearly across the foreground face and shoulders, leaving background figures in varied midtones. The perspective is shallow, with the large seated figure separating clearly from the smaller clustered diners. Loose linework keeps the restaurant lively, while decisive black masses prevent the details from becoming diffuse. No readable signage or lettering appears. The overall composition combines a glamorous foreground pause with a restless crowd, using graphic ink contrast and economical draftsmanship to make the scene cinematic.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑墨与奶油色纸面的漫画插画描绘拥挤的晚间餐厅，一位从容女子占据前景。她穿长款无袖黑礼服，坐在右下方，一只手撑在身边，躯干转向观者。深色波浪发围着镇定的面孔，眼神直接，嘴唇由锐利线条勾出。左侧，衣着正式的食客围着浅色桌布坐着，手势和重叠椅子暗示交谈。她身后，穿深色西装的男子站在轻描的墙面板和拱门之间，构成热闹但克制的社交背景。女子的礼服是一整片几乎不断裂的黑墨色域，与浅色手臂和暖奶油色纸面形成最强对比。面孔由细排线和清脆轮廓塑形，房间更深处则化成较粗糙迅速的笔触。阴影积于家具下方和拱门内，但看不见明确的灯。暗示性的室内光最明显地落在前景脸与肩上，背景人物停留在多种中间调中。空间纵深较浅，大尺度坐姿人物与较小的聚集食客清楚分离。松动线条让餐厅活跃，果断黑色块面则避免细节涣散。画面没有可读招牌或文字。整体构图把华美的前景停顿与躁动人群结合，以图形化墨色对比和简练绘图使场景富有电影感。
style_prompt_en: A classic black-ink comic illustration style on warm cream paper, alternating confident solid-black masses with lively fine hatching and quick peripheral strokes. Crisp contours and precise focal faces give way to looser background description. High value contrast establishes an immediate center, while overlapping midtone silhouettes suggest a busy shallow space. Light is implied by reserved paper white and selective ink shadow rather than painted gradients. The drawing is cinematic, economical, and rhythmic, with large calm dark shapes balancing dense small marks.
style_prompt_zh: 暖奶油色纸上的经典黑墨漫画插画风格，自信的整片浓黑与活跃细排线、快速外围笔触交替。清脆轮廓和精确的视觉中心逐渐过渡到更松散的背景描述。高明度反差立即建立中心，重叠的中间调剪影暗示繁忙而浅的空间。光由保留的纸白和选择性墨影暗示，而非绘制渐层。画面有电影感、简练且富于节奏，大而安静的暗色形态平衡密集小笔痕。
theme_en: A poised woman in a dark gown amid a busy evening restaurant
theme_zh: 晚间餐厅里，一名穿深色礼服的女子从容坐在忙碌人群前
name: Milton Caniff
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
